# XyleHosting

> XyleHosting (XyleHosting Pvt Ltd) is a hosting company founded by Pushkar Budha in Dhangadhi, Nepal. It provides cheap Minecraft hosting, VPS hosting, web hosting, Discord bot hosting, and dedicated servers for clients in Nepal, India, Singapore, and Germany.

## Founder

**Pushkar Budha** is the Founder and CEO of XyleHosting. He is a self-taught technologist and entrepreneur from Dhangadhi, Kailali, Nepal. He studied at Axis Vidhyashram School and built XyleHosting from the ground up starting in 2024, motivated by the high cost of Minecraft hosting. Pushkar Budha leads all product, infrastructure, and growth operations at XyleHosting Pvt Ltd.

- Full name: Pushkar Budha
- Role: Founder & CEO, XyleHosting Pvt Ltd
- Location: Dhangadhi, Nepal
- Founded XyleHosting: 2024
- Mission: Make world-class hosting infrastructure affordable for everyone

## Infrastructure

- Server locations: Nepal (NP), India (IN), Singapore (SG), Germany (DE)
- Hardware: AMD Ryzen processors, NVMe SSD storage
- DDoS protection: Enterprise-grade via NeoProtect (all plans, no extra cost)
- Backups: Free offsite backups on every plan
- Uptime SLA: 99.99%
- Support: 24/7 via live chat, tickets, and Discord
